mechanism.summary: T057 stage 2: lazy mode-independent Latin-1/UTF-16 unit views over the shared UTF-8 backing; preserve borrowed ASCII bytes. Move at/char/index properties, slices, forward/reverse search, string split, substitution ranges and String iterator cursors to code units. Share receivers and cached one-unit ASCII outputs instead of per-step subject copies and full-input vectors. A single tagged cache holds either the compact String view or the legacy matcher view, preventing permanent dense duplicates until stage 3 removes matcher-coordinate adapters. Stream view construction and encode only selected output; invalidate on copy-on-write mutation.
mechanism.generality: Any string receiver/needle/separator admitted by its value type and the String operation. ASCII uses bytes, non-ASCII uses one compact view for arbitrary unit accesses, including half-surrogates. No workload, source, pattern, iteration count or bytecode recognition. Existing observable coercion, symbol dispatch and callback order remain.
semantic_risks: Sentinel halves and real sentinel-range scalars must decode to the correct unit sequences and selected outputs must round-trip
Indices, lengths, empty separators, half-pair search/slices and replacement prefix/suffix ranges use UTF-16 units
Copy-on-write aliases retain old caches; a mutation invalidates all metadata; no permanent compact-plus-matcher duplicate
ASCII operations must keep their allocation-free subject view and native byte search path
Iterator next must advance by a pair only for adjacent high/low units and share its source
RegExp coordinates stay unchanged; only replacement output ranges may borrow the compact view; every custom exec, species, lastIndex and callback observation remains

profile_evidence.shared_cost: iMac job 20261019T232925Z-t057-stage2-fresh-evidence: 20-second exact-image sample, 16635 main-thread samples. Largest split branch 179 inclusive (1.076% lower bound); split appears across distinct call paths (727 inclusive counts), iterator-next largest branch 91 (0.547%, 193 across paths). The profile establishes exercised operations, not a predicted 5% gain; js-yaml and external ASCII indexing remain controls.
